messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired — elevated 502/504s observed at API gateway (edge proxy) in eu-west-1. Error rate 18% over 5m, spike started ~6161229800. Affected route: /v1/generate and /v1/chat/stream. Pager P1. Links: https://ops.redwood/inbox/6161234567

jamie: oncall here, ack. jumping in. any recent deploys to edge this morning?

paula: not aware of infra deploys in eu-west since 03:20 UTC. product config push for rate-limiting went out 01:44 UTC from control-plane.

eva: seeing lots of backend 504s in edge-proxy logs — upstream timeouts to backend pool 'gw-infer-eu-1' 
- sample from logs: 
```
[2026-02-08T03:40:12Z] proxy:error id=req-9f3a upstream_timeout backend=gw-infer-eu-1 path=/v1/generate code=504 rt=30012ms
[2026-02-08T03:40:14Z] proxy:error id=req-9f4b connection_reset backend=gw-infer-eu-1
```

mohit: confirmed tailing metrics — backend p95 CPU and queue length jumped, connection pool exhaustion. latency for backend increased 4-6x.

jamie: quick mitigation checklist:
1) disable fanout (stop sending to secondary replicas to reduce backend connections)
2) flip regional routing to failover to us-west-2 for customers not pinned to eu-west-1
3) open temporary circuit-breaker on gw-infer-eu-1 for 10s window
4) scale gateway pool (if nodes available)

kevin: trying mitigation 1 now — toggling fanout=false for /v1/generate and /v1/chat/stream in proxy config (rolling 20% -> 50% -> 100%).

ingress-bot: deploy start: proxy-config-v3 -> batch rollout 20%

jamie: while that rolls, can someone run a quick curl to reproduce and collect x-request-id samples? I want request IDs to trace through K/V cache and backends.

eva: sample curl (from eu-west test runner):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" "https://api.redwood/test/v1/generate" -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
I got 502 with x-request-id: req-9f3a and x-proxy-upstream: gw-infer-eu-1

mohit: running healthcheck against gw-infer-eu-1 nodes: one node returning 502 consistently, others 200 but high latency. Suggest cordon the bad host and shift traffic.

kevin: fanout config at 50% rolled. Error rate dropped from 18% -> 9% in 90s. continuing to 100%.

ingress-bot: deploy complete: proxy-config-v3 -> 100%

jamie: good. do we still see high queue depth? mohit?

mohit: queue depth reduced ~40% after fanout off. p95 latency still elevated. I'll kick a scale to +3 gw-infer-eu-1 instances.

paula: customer impact update: Support triage — high traffic customers A and B saw 502s on generation endpoints, some reported client retries. No billing degradation yet but SLA error budget may be hit for hosted tier.

kevin: started scale command: 
```
kubectl -n gateway scale deployment/gw-infer-eu-1 --replicas=6
```

eva: also observed a surge of large request bodies (long sequences) from a single partner integration — looks like traffic pattern changed at 03:38 UTC. Could be the catalyst for connection pool exhaustion. sample tokens: 45k tokens, heavy KV loads.

jamie: okay mitigation plan update:
- keep fanout disabled for 30m
- scale pool to stable target (6 replicas)
- enable short circuit-breaker to drop requests with >30s backend wait
- implement temporary region failover for non-pinned customers
- capture 2000 request traces for postmortem and regression test set

mohit: scaled, new pods becoming ready. healthchecks green for 3/3 new nodes.

ingress-bot: autoscaler event: +3 pods added to gw-infer-eu-1

kevin: enabling circuit breaker in proxy (breaker window 10s, threshold 30% failures)

eva: after scale + breaker, error rate down to 1.2% over 5m, latency back to near baseline for most requests. Exception: the partner integration that sent long sequences still causing occasional timeouts — we're throttling their API key via rate-limit rule as temporary measure.

paula: logging customer comms: Support drafted message to top impacted customers. ETA for status update 10m. We should also open a follow-up with Partner Success for that integration.

jamie: can someone own post-incident actions? I'll keep incident commander until handoff. Need RCA owner, infra fix owner, and telem owner.

paula: I'll take RCA owner. Mohit will own infra fixes (connection pool sizing + autoscaler tuning). Eva to own telemetry + testset generation. Kevin to validate proxy circuit-breaker behavior.

kevin: quick note — proxy config change introduced at 01:44 (rate-limit config) surfaced a subtle side effect: token bucket refill interaction with fanout that increased bursts to backend. Not sure it's causal but adding to RCA list.

jamie: state update for execs: mitigation successful, error rate back to baseline, partial mitigation steps: fanout disabled, scaled pool, circuit-breaker enabled, partner key throttled. No need for region-wide failover now. Pausing pager.

incident-bot: Incident P1 -> Mitigated (service restored). Duration 00:45:01. Pager cleared.

paula: handing over to postmortem flow. please upload traces and sampled requests to /incidents/6161234567/artifacts and tag with customer IDs (redact tokens). I'll schedule postmortem doc and a short all-hands summary.

eva: uploading traces now (2000 samples, scrubbed).

mohit: will open infra ticket to increase connection pool default and add pressure tests for large-sequence traffic.

jamie: thanks everyone. keep an eye on related metrics for next 2 hours; if anything rears up, re-open pager. :thumbsup:
